title: Selecting an action by read offset
statement: Let $M$ be a machine in code normal form, let $q$ be one of its states, and let $u$ and $v$ each be either blank, $0$, or $1$. The list of the nine transition actions for $q$ has length $9$, and its entry at the index determined by the ordered pair $(u,v)$ is the transition action of $M$ at state $q$ when the input read is $u$ and the work-tape read is $v$.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a machine in code normal form
$u$ is an optional Boolean input read
$v$ is an optional Boolean work-tape read
replaced:
For every coded machine, state $q$, and pair of optional input and work reads,
the nine-action list of $q$ has length $9$, and its entry at the record index
determined by the two reads (a number in $\{0,\dots,8\}$) is exactly the
machine's transition action for $q$ on those reads.
